verdict.rationale: Exa hosts an llms.txt at exa.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and provides markdown-rendered docs pages with a documentation index (llms.txt) for AI consumption, directly supporting agent-oriented doc access; it also ships an official MCP server for connecting assistants. missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation that agents actually consume and parse these docs successfully, and no openapi.json spec found which could complement agent-oriented docs.
